facts.quote: It is long-lived, with some specimens in France surviving for 200 years.
The number of seeds in a pomegranate can vary from 200 to about 1,400.

facts.text: Snese mírný mráz až do asi −12 °C.
facts.quote: They can tolerate moderate frost, down to about −12 °C (10 °F).

facts.text: Snáší sucho a roste i v suchých oblastech.
facts.quote: Pomegranates are drought-tolerant, and can be grown in dry areas

facts.text: Zralé nesklizené plody přitahují ovocné mušky a mravence.
facts.quote: Fruit flies and ants are attracted to unharvested ripe fruit.

facts.text: Slupky plodů se používají k barvení vlny a hedvábí.
facts.quote: Pomegranate peels may be used to stain wool and silk in the carpet industry.
